roleLabel: Crit Assassin finisher — leaps shurikens onto the lowest-HP enemy and scales with Stealth/Poison
bestFor: Boards that can create low-HP targets and Crit so Shadow Strike cleans up
strength: Always aims the weakest enemy; Crit count on shurikens and Nightshade vs Poison spike hard
weakness: Whiffs when nothing is low yet; dies if she leaps into focus without Stealth windows

howToPlay.early: Pair with a damage partner who softens packs. Crit tools matter immediately. She is a finisher, not wave one tank.
howToPlay.mid: Shadow = HP threshold Stealth once per combat + permanent scaling on Stealth. Collector = extra shuriken and kill Shard growth. Nightshade = +Crit vs Poisoned and Assassin Crit spreads Poison. Pick personal Stealth, Shard snowball, or Poison tribal.
howToPlay.late: Assassin Ambush/Smokescreen and Crit relics. Keep feeding low-HP targets so the leap always has a job.
howToPlay.positioning: Mid-back so the leap reaches the collapsing target without eating the first volley.

abilityNotes.Shuriken Shadow Strike: Lowest-HP targeting is automatic triage. Soften first — full-HP casts feel weak even with good Crit.

specNotes.The Shadow: Stealth clutch + permanent gains when Stealth procs. Take for personal survivability/scaling.
specNotes.The Collector: Extra shuriken and Shard growth on kills. Take when she can secure executes often.
specNotes.The Nightshade: Poison Assassin tribal — Crit vs Poisoned. Take with Poison applicators (Pimenta, etc.).

faq.question: Is Yuuna good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: High ceiling finisher with Crit/Poison support. Poor as a solo early board. Buy her to clean up, not to open.

faq.question: What class is Yuuna?
faq.answer: Assassin. Role focus: Crit shuriken leap onto the lowest-health enemy.

faq.question: What relics work with Yuuna?
faq.answer: Assassin Smokescreen/Ambush/Supremacy pieces and Crit/Poison enablers.

faq.question: How do you play Yuuna?
faq.answer: Soften packs, stack Crit, cast Shadow Strike on collapsing targets, and pick Shadow, Collector, or Nightshade based on Stealth, Shards, or Poison.

tips: If she leaps and dies, you needed Stealth timing or a tank — not only more Attack.
Nightshade without Poison on the board is a weak Crit branch; apply Poison first.
